messages:
mia kim: Heads-up UI review — proposed micro change to Usage page. Putting the org/project scope toggle inline with the time-range is confusing; users expect it near the ledger. Also the token breakdown table is visually lost under the main spend chart. Thoughts?

samir: Agree re: toggle. I keep clicking the time-range. +1 to moving scope near the account selector or making it a clear 'View by' control.

jonah: From eng POV moving the toggle is fine. If we change placement we should rename the API param (scope -> owner) to be explicit. Backwards compat note: leave alias for old param.

tara (design): Quick sketches posted: https://redwood-internal/designs/usage-toggle-v2 — tried a compact horizontal toggle and a 'View by' dropdown. Dropdown wins for dense screens and keyboard navigation.

mia kim: Accessibility nit: current chart palette fails WCAG AA when legend text is small. Low-contrast legend chips + small hit targets = poor discoverability. We should increase contrast and target size.

samir: Also propose making legend items clickable to isolate a series (expected behavior). Keyboard focus + visible outline needed.

tara (design): Agreed. Proposed specs: legend font 12px -> 14px, contrast delta +6, hit target min 44px. Add aria-labels like "toggle tokens breakdown by model" and role=button on legend items.

jonah: Implementation note — interactive legend requires us to stopPropagation on clicks because our chart wrapper intercepts events. I can spike this on a branch; we use recharts hooks so should be straightforward.

billing-bot: invoice-ready: invoice-2025-07.pdf for acct-1234 — /invoices/download/acct-1234/2025-07.pdf

mia kim: UX question — should invoice CTA live inside the Spend card or in a separate Billing rail? My read: users check invoices when reviewing last-month spend, so inline CTA makes sense but must be prominent and semantically clear: "Download invoice (PDF)".

tara (design): If inline, avoid duplicate CTAs. Make primary action "Download invoice" and a subtle link "View billing history" that goes to Billing page. Keep spacing so it doesn't compete with the spend sparkline.

samir: Implementation constraint: PDF preview increases bundle size. Recommend download-only in v1, link out to Billing for preview.

jonah: I'll scope legend interactivity + aria updates in the sprint. Blockers: none immediate; dependency is chart lib upgrade if we need better event hooks. ETA prototype: end of next week.

mia kim: Action items: tara update mocks (toggle + legend specs), jonah spike interactive legend + keyboard, samir confirm API renaming/aliasing and invoice link UX, i'll file small a11y ticket and coordinate testing. :white_check_mark:

samir: sounds good. Thanks team! :tada:
